cards.title: Hardware & Network
cards.description: Prepare PC, laptop or tablet running Google Chrome or Edge with stable internet connection.

cards.title: Company Credentials
cards.description: Obtain registered Company Code (e.g. C001) and Admin username/password provided by Isarva.

cards.title: Business Details
cards.description: Have restaurant legal trade name, 15-digit VAT number, and branch address documentation ready.

cards.title: Security & Offline
cards.description: Keep passwords confidential. System continues taking orders offline and syncs upon reconnection.

POS-B01.heading: Activate This POS Till
POS-B01.body: Permanently bind this browser terminal to your restaurant using the authorized company code.
bullets: Navigate to official application URL in Chrome or Edge
Locate Activate POS card on the initial landing screen
Enter registered Company Code C001 in the input box
Tap Activate POS button to bind hardware to restaurant
Confirm restaurant legal name is displayed on screen

POS-B02.heading: Sign In with Admin PIN
POS-B02.body: Authenticate staff and manager credentials using the on-screen numeric keypad or keyboard.
bullets: Enter designated staff username into the Username field
Type security PIN or password using physical or touch keypad
Tap Show PIN button if password verification is required
Tap orange OK button to authenticate and unlock system
Access role-authorized POS dashboard and till controls

POS-B03.heading: Main Restaurant Dashboard
POS-B03.body: Central command center displaying live till sales, kitchen queues, and quick order launch pads.
bullets: Verify assigned till branch H001 - Head Office at top bar
Monitor live metrics: Open Tables, Billing, and Kitchen Queue
Switch bilingual interface between English and Arabic
Launch front-of-house services: Dine In, Takeaway, Drive Thru
Access back-office tools: Day Close, Expenses, and Settings

cards.title: Hardware Power On
cards.description: Power on POS terminals, receipt printers, kitchen display units, and verify router Wi-Fi.

cards.title: Branch Verification
cards.description: Log into POS and confirm top header displays correct branch: H001 - Head Office.

cards.title: Network Health
cards.description: Ensure green Connected badge is active. Offline mode activates automatically if network drops.

cards.title: Opening Cash Float
cards.description: Open Day Open module, count till physical float cash, enter starting SAR amount, and begin.

POS-D01.heading: Interactive Table Seating Floor Plan
POS-D01.body: Select dining zones, seat guests on interactive floor tables, and build order tickets.
bullets: Open Dine In or Floor service from the main dashboard
Switch between Architectural Diagram and Table List view
Monitor dining zones: Main Hall, Family Section, Outdoor
Check real-time table status: Free, Occupied, and Billing
Tap any vacant table to seat guests and launch order ticket

POS-D02.heading: Discounts & Extra Charges
POS-D02.subheading: Configurable Order Adjustments & Legal VAT Calculations

items.title: Preset Discount Pills
items.description: Apply quick percentage discounts (0%, 7%, 10%) directly on the order ticket based on staff privileges.

items.title: Custom Discount SAR
items.description: Authorized managers can enter custom flat SAR discount values or special customer concessions.

items.title: Extra Service Charges
items.description: Toggle optional service fees, valet parking, or private dining charges configured in Settings.

items.title: 15% VAT Display
items.description: Every ticket clearly itemizes Net Subtotal, Discount, Extra Charges, and 15% VAT breakdown.

items.title: Item-Level Voiding
items.description: Void un-sent items instantly; sent kitchen items require manager PIN authorization to delete.

items.title: Audit Tracking
items.description: All discounts, voids, and waivers are permanently logged for financial audit reporting.

POS-D02.tip_note: Tax rates cannot be edited manually on the floor; updates are managed in Settings -> Tax.

cards.title: Save Order
cards.description: Save current open ticket to floor map without sending preparation instructions to kitchen.

cards.title: KOT to Screen
cards.description: Tap KOT to dispatch items electronically to Kitchen Display Screens (KDS) paperlessly.

cards.title: KOT & Print
cards.description: Send items to kitchen screens AND trigger thermal paper ticket printing at cooking stations.

cards.title: Save & Bill Preview
cards.description: Print interim guest check slip for customer review prior to final payment settlement.

cards.title: Change Table
cards.description: Move active guest orders to another vacant table when customers switch dining locations.

cards.title: Merge Tables
cards.description: Combine multiple seated tables into a single unified ticket when guest parties join together.

cards.title: Split Initiator
cards.description: Initiate split bill directly from floor ticket to prepare multi-guest payment settlements.

cards.title: Table Area Switch
cards.description: Switch seamlessly between Main Dining Hall, Outdoor Terrace, and Family Section views.

POS-E01.heading: Flexible Payment & Settlement Hub

items.title: One-Touch Fast Settle
items.description: Tap 'Rest -> Cash', 'Rest -> mada', or 'Rest -> Apple Pay' to settle entire balance in 1 click.

items.title: Equal Split
items.description: Divide ticket evenly across 2, 3, 4+ guests. Collect each portion via individual cash or card tenders.

items.title: Custom Tender Split
items.description: Combine multiple tenders: e.g. SAR 150 Cash + remaining SAR 85 balance via mada debit card.

items.title: Food Vouchers
items.description: Enter promotional voucher code. System validates eligibility and deducts credit immediately.

items.title: Gift Cards & Loyalty
items.description: Redeem stored value gift cards or customer CRM loyalty points directly against amount due.

items.title: Integrated SoftPOS
items.description: Hardware bridge communicates directly with payment terminals for secure contactless processing.

POS-E01.tip_note: Confirm payment button unlocks exclusively when Remaining balance reaches exactly SAR 0.00.

POS-E02.heading: Order Settlement & Tender Screen
POS-E02.body: Finalize customer tickets with multi-tender payment methods and instant invoice generation.
bullets: Tap Settle button on active ticket to open settlement modal
Select payment method: Cash, mada Card, or Digital Wallet
Enter cash received to automatically calculate customer change
Split ticket into equal parts or custom amounts if requested
Tap Complete Settlement to generate ZATCA fiscal receipt

cards.title: Food Vouchers
cards.description: Create promotional vouchers in Settings. Enter code at checkout for automated bill deduction.

cards.title: Prepaid Gift Cards
cards.description: Issue customer gift cards with balance tracking. Swipe or enter card serial number on settle.

cards.title: CRM Loyalty Points
cards.description: Look up customer profile by mobile number to redeem accumulated loyalty points for cash discounts.

cards.title: SoftPOS Terminal
cards.description: Push invoice totals directly to countertop or mobile SoftPOS card readers over local network.

POS-FG01.heading: Takeaway, Drive-Thru & Aggregators
POS-FG01.body: Fast order capture for counter takeaway, car pickup, and integrated delivery aggregator orders.
bullets: Select Takeaway or Drive Thru directly from service launchpad
Assign customer name, phone number, or token buzzer ID
Add fast-food items and combo modifiers to quick ticket
Receive online aggregator orders (HungerStation, Jahez, Keeta)
Process immediate payment and dispatch order to kitchen

POS-HI01.heading: Kitchen Display & Rider Dispatch
POS-HI01.body: Paperless kitchen display system with order bumping, station filters, and delivery rider handoff.
bullets: Open KDS module to view incoming kitchen tickets in real time
Filter tickets by prep station: Grill, Fryer, Salad, or Bar
Monitor elapsed cook timers color-coded for fast SLA fulfillment
Tap ticket card to bump status from Cooking to Ready for Expo
Assign prepared delivery parcels to active mobile delivery riders

POS-JP01.heading: Daily Till Shift & Cash Reconciliation
POS-JP01.body: Mandatory end-of-day audit reconciling actual drawer cash against recorded POS ledger sales.
bullets: Verify all floor tables and delivery tickets are fully settled
Open Day Close module to initiate end-of-shift cash audit
Count drawer bank notes and coins by denomination into till count
Review automated variance between counted cash and POS ledger
Confirm Day Close to lock sales shift and generate Z-Report

POS-KL01.heading: Business Profile & ZATCA Phase 2
POS-KL01.body: Configure legal entity details, restaurant branches, tax rates, and KSA e-invoicing compliance.
bullets: Open Settings module to configure restaurant business profile
Enter legal trade name, 15-digit VAT number, and CR number
Set branch addresses and contact information for receipt headers
Upload ZATCA CSID certificate and enter compliance OTP token
Monitor live ZATCA invoice queue for accepted B2B and B2C bills

cards.title: Receipt Printers
cards.description: Configure counter thermal receipt printers with ESC/POS LAN IP addresses and paper cut options.

cards.title: KOT Station Printers
cards.description: Set up independent kitchen printers for Hot Kitchen, Cold Kitchen, Sushi Bar, and Beverage Bar.

cards.title: Printer Mapping
cards.description: Map menu departments to specific printers: e.g. Burgers -> Kitchen, Drinks -> Juice Bar.

cards.title: Receipt Header & Footer
cards.description: Customize invoice headers with logo, VAT registration, Arabic notes, and ZATCA QR codes.

POS-N01.heading: Food Menu & Order Ticket Builder
POS-N01.body: Browse dish categories, customize item add-ons, and build order tickets with live VAT breakdown.
bullets: Browse menu categories: Starters, Mains, Soups, Salads
Select dishes with selling prices and custom modifiers
Review real-time ticket subtotals and 15% VAT calculation
Dispatch food orders directly to kitchen display or printers
Proceed to Settle for cash, card, or split payment processing

POS-O01.heading: Staff Accounts & Role Privileges
POS-O01.subheading: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Granular Access Control & Security Policies

items.title: Restaurant Admin
items.description: Full system permissions: menu pricing, tax updates, user management, day close, and Z-reports.

items.title: Cashier
items.description: Order creation, tender settlement, split bills, customer receipts, and shift cash float drawer counts.

items.title: Food Server / Waiter
items.description: Table seating, ticket taking, kitchen KOT dispatch, modifiers, and guest bill check printing.

items.title: Kitchen Manager
items.description: KDS screen access, order preparation bumping, station filters, and 86 out-of-stock item toggling.

items.title: Delivery Rider
items.description: Mobile app login with last 4 phone digits, parcel assignment, order tracking, and COD reconciliation.

items.title: Manager Authorization
items.description: Protected operations (order voiding, discounts > 10%, price overrides) enforce manager PIN entry.

POS-O01.tip_note: Never share admin passwords; each employee must operate under a unique staff username and PIN.

POS-QR01.heading: Inventory, Recipes & Storage Control
POS-QR01.body: Track raw ingredient stocks, vendor purchase orders, recipe yield deductions, and internal transfers.
bullets: Access Stock module from sidebar to monitor ingredient counts
Define storage locations: Main Storage, Cold Room, Kitchen Prep
Create Purchase Orders and record supplier ingredient receiving
Link recipe BOM ingredients to automatically deduct upon sales
Perform weekly physical stock counts to track wastage variance

cards.title: Catalog Export
cards.description: Export complete menu catalog, products, and customer profiles into secure Excel/CSV files.

cards.title: Catalog Import
cards.description: Bulk import new menu items and prices safely using official Isarva spreadsheet templates.

cards.title: Automated Backups
cards.description: Cloud-synchronized encrypted backups secure transactional data under ISO 27001 standards.

cards.title: Safe Data Cleaning
cards.description: Restricted to authorized administrators. Cleaning tools permanently purge old test bills only.

POS-T01.heading: Business Intelligence & Audit Reports
POS-T01.body: Comprehensive operational analytics, sales summaries, void audits, and tax liability reports.
bullets: Open Reports module from sidebar for complete business analytics
Generate Daily Sales Summary with gross revenue and VAT totals
Analyze peak rush hours using the Hourly Sales Distribution chart
Inspect Void & Discount Audit logs to prevent cashier leakage
Export tender reconciliation reports for accounting and tax filing

POS-U01.heading: Front-of-House Navigation Hub
POS-U01.body: Quick access across all daily operational modules, customer profiles, barcodes, and shifts.
bullets: Access Customer directory for CRM profiles and contact history
Use Barcode scanning mode for rapid retail packaging checkout
Review Unsettled orders table to verify pending dine-in checks
Monitor live queue counters for cooking tickets and open tables
Track employee attendance time clock and staff working hours

cards.title: Company & Legal Tax
cards.description: Register restaurant legal name, 15-digit VAT number, branch locations, and ZATCA Phase 2 credentials.

cards.title: Users & Role Privileges
cards.description: Create staff user accounts, configure PIN passwords, and assign cashier/server role permissions.

cards.title: Floor & Product Catalog
cards.description: Build floor layout zones, create table numbers, import food categories, dishes, and 15% VAT.

cards.title: End-to-End Test Ticket
cards.description: Run test order: seat table, add food, route KOT, execute split payment, and verify invoice QR.

POS-W01.heading: Common POS Problems & Solutions
POS-W01.subheading: Instant Field Remediation Protocols for Front-Line Restaurant Operations

items.title: Offline Mode Notice
items.description: Verify Wi-Fi or LAN cable. POS continues taking local orders; offline cache syncs automatically.

items.title: KOT / Bill Not Printing
items.description: Check thermal paper roll orientation, power switch, and verify printer IP mapping in Settings.

items.title: Cannot Settle Bill
items.description: Ensure tendered payment amount exactly matches or exceeds remaining balance before tapping OK.

items.title: Void / Discount Disabled
items.description: Front-line servers require Admin or Manager authorization PIN to cancel sent kitchen tickets.

items.title: Card SoftPOS Declined
items.description: Reconnect Bluetooth terminal, verify POS network bridge, or switch to manual card tender.

items.title: Sales Report Shows Zero
items.description: Check date/time range filter and ensure current cashier shift Day Open has completed sales.

POS-W01.tip_note: Contact Isarva 24/7 technical hotline for urgent on-site hardware or ZATCA gateway assistance.

POS-XY01.heading: Nightly Closing & Data Security Rules

items.title: Settle Open Orders
items.description: Ensure zero open tables, pending takeaway checks, or active delivery tickets remain unsettled.

items.title: Till Drawer Audit
items.description: Count actual drawer currency, enter counts in Day Close, record variance, and print Z-Report.

items.title: Sync & Cloud Backup
items.description: Verify all offline cash records are synchronized to central cloud servers before turning off till.

items.title: Cardholder Privacy
items.description: Strictly prohibited: Never write down or store customer payment card numbers or CVV codes.

items.title: Hardware Shutdown
items.description: Log out user sessions, shut down thermal printers, and turn off terminal display safely.

items.title: Compliance Archive
items.description: File signed daily Z-Reports and merchant credit card transaction batches for accounting audits.

POS-XY01.tip_note: All system activity is cryptographically logged under ISO/IEC 27001 data protection protocols.
